findings.title: Moderate Advisory in Routing Dependency (react-router-dom / react-router)
findings.description: Advisories GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 and GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg identify moderate issues in react-router versions <7.18.0. The SSR hydration vector does not impact this static SPA.
findings.evidence: react-router-dom@6.28.1 relies on react-router@6.28.1. Fix available in react-router-dom@7.18.4 (semver major). Static SPA does not utilize SSR hydration.
findings.impact: Low actual operational impact on static GitHub Pages client; potential open redirect under non-standard Link usage.
findings.expectedResult: Zero moderate or higher dependencies, or confirmed mitigation documentation.
findings.actualResult: 4 moderate advisories reported by npm audit.
findings.remediation: Evaluate migration to react-router-dom v7.x or apply patch when compatible.

findings.title: Moderate Advisory in Test Tooling (vitest / @vitest/mocker)
findings.description: Advisory GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 identifies path traversal in @vitest/mocker during test execution. This package is strictly a devDependency and is NEVER bundled or shipped into production client assets.
findings.evidence: vitest@3.0.5 is listed in devDependencies and stripped from production dist/ by Vite.
findings.impact: Zero production runtime impact. Isolated to local or CI test execution environment.
findings.expectedResult: Clean devDependencies audit or documented isolation.
findings.actualResult: Moderate advisory in test runner dependency.
findings.remediation: Update vitest to v5.x when migration path is ready.
